SOM.note: No authentication, e-signature or digital wallet service stated.
No link between civil register and ID stated.
Nothing on the central bank's payments role.
Nothing on digital finance consumer protection.
Nothing on government payments to people.
States over 1 million registered as of November 2025 but gives no population or share.

facts.fact: UNDP Somalia says NIRA deployed its own trained staff, equipment and biometric technology to run the Baidoa registrations and is processing 12,000 to 15,000 registrations a day.

SOM.note: Only says services such as bank accounts will require the ID from January 2026; no public register keyed on it.

facts.fact: UNDP Somalia says NIRA's national ID system, launched in September 2023, had registered over 1 million Somalis with biometric digital identity by November 2025.

SOM.note: No statement that biometrics check against duplicate enrolment, and no certification or audit.
Nothing on local government office connection.

facts.fact: UNDP Somalia says a Baidoa pilot with NIRA registered 38,026 internally displaced people for the national ID in one month.
UNDP Somalia says displaced people in Baidoa enrolled in the national digital ID system, and that from January 2026 the ID will be required for services such as opening a bank account.
UNDP Somalia counts 38,026 internally displaced people enrolled in the national ID in the Baidoa pilot, against 500,000 IDPs in Baidoa.
